metric_policy.complete_package_note: Complete package includes generated MBIST wrappers, algorithms, saboteur/model RTL, and staged SRAM behavioral models.
metric_policy.storage_note: Unpacked behavioral memory arrays are reported as memory_bit_count, not flipflop_count.

registers.name: REG_00_STATUS_LO
registers.description: Status telemetry byte 0. Encodes low-status indicators from the top-level status_telemetry vector.

fields.name: STATUS0
fields.description: status_telemetry[7:0]. Field packing is implementation-defined but must include only registered status bits from the top-level telemetry vector.

registers.name: REG_01_STATUS_HI
registers.description: Status telemetry byte 1. Encodes remaining status indicators from the top-level status_telemetry vector.

fields.name: STATUS1
fields.description: status_telemetry[15:8]. Field packing is implementation-defined but must include only registered status bits from the top-level telemetry vector.

registers.name: REG_02_FAULT_CODE
registers.description: Top-level fault code. Mirrors the safety_supervisor fault_code output.

fields.name: FAULT_CODE
fields.description: fault_code[3:0]. Encodes unsupported geometry, operating-envelope violation, stale response, transaction mismatch, and external fault input per implementation-defined fixed mapping.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved; reads as zero.

fields.name: SAFE_MODE
fields.description: Registered safe_mode indication. Active when any monitored safety criterion fails.

fields.name: SUPERVISOR_RELEASE
fields.description: Registered command release authorization to the saturator.

fields.name: FALLBACK_ACTIVE
fields.description: Registered indication that fallback_fsm is selected or required.

fields.name: STALE_COMMAND
fields.description: Registered stale_command indication from safety supervision.

fields.name: REQUEST_OUTSTANDING
fields.description: Registered outstanding transaction state from model_txn_mgr.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved; reads as zero.

fields.name: GEOMETRY_ACCEPT
fields.description: geometry_valid. Asserted only when vehicle_geometry_valid is accepted and geometry_format is STL-compatible with valid metadata.

fields.name: GEOMETRY_REJECT
fields.description: geometry_reject. Asserted when unsupported geometry format or malformed metadata is detected.

fields.name: GEOMETRY_SOURCE
fields.description: Latched geometry_source tag from the accepted geometry descriptor context. Meaning is implementation-defined and descriptive only.

fields.name: GEOMETRY_FORMAT
fields.description: Latched geometry_format indicator summary. Must reflect the accepted format encoding used by geometry_ingress.

fields.name: FLOW_VALID
fields.description: flow_valid. Asserted only when stream_velocity_mps is within the approved operating envelope of 20 m/s to 55 m/s inclusive.

fields.name: ENVELOPE_FAULT
fields.description: envelope_fault. Asserted when stream_velocity_mps is outside the approved envelope.

fields.name: NOMINAL_CONDITION
fields.description: Informational nominal condition indication for the supplied 38.89 m/s reference point within the fixed-point implementation.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved; reads as zero.

registers.name: REG_06_REQ_ID_LO
registers.description: Request ID low byte from model_txn_mgr.

fields.name: REQ_ID_LO
fields.description: req_id[7:0]. Monotonically increasing request ID for issued model transactions.

registers.name: REG_07_REQ_ID_HI
registers.description: Request ID high byte from model_txn_mgr.

fields.name: REQ_ID_HI
fields.description: req_id[15:8]. Monotonically increasing request ID for issued model transactions.

registers.name: REG_08_REQ_VALID
registers.description: Request handshake status and acceptance flags.

fields.name: REQ_VALID
fields.description: req_valid. Asserted when a request packet is launched to the external surrogate service.

fields.name: REQ_READY_SEEN
fields.description: Implementation-defined registered indication that req_ready was observed during request gating.

fields.name: FRESH_RESPONSE_PULSE
fields.description: fresh_response_pulse from model_txn_mgr. Pulses when a fresh matching response is accepted.

fields.name: RESPONSE_MISMATCH
fields.description: response_mismatch from model_txn_mgr. Indicates resp_id or freshness mismatch for the outstanding request.

fields.name: RESPONSE_FRESH
fields.description: response_fresh from model_txn_mgr. Indicates the current response path is fresh and matched.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved; reads as zero.

fields.name: OUTSTANDING_REQ_ID_LO
fields.description: outstanding_req_id[7:0]. Mirrors the request ID currently awaiting response.

fields.name: OUTSTANDING_REQ_ID_HI
fields.description: outstanding_req_id[15:8]. Mirrors the request ID currently awaiting response.

fields.name: OUTSTANDING_TS_0
fields.description: outstanding_req_timestamp[7:0]. Captured at request issuance from the internal synchronous timebase.
